title: Payment-History Adjustment to Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Settlement Percentages
content:
**Training note — payment history and the settlement percentage, Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract**

The settlement percentage on a deficiency under a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract follows the installment payments and extensions posted on the contract.

| Installment payments posted | Extensions ever posted | Adjustment |
|---|---|---|
| 24 or more (the long-history count) | none | lowered by 5 points (the long-history points) |
| 24 or more | one or more | unchanged |
| 12 to 23 | any | unchanged |
| Fewer than 12 (the short-history count) | any | raised by 10 points (the short-history points) |

**Q. Which payments count?** Payments posted for an installment. A reinstatement payment, a payoff or any other payment purpose is not an installment payment.

**Q. A contract shows 30 installment payments and one extension. What adjustment applies?** None — the long-history lowering needs no extension ever posted, and 30 is not fewer than 12.

**Q. A contract shows 11 installment payments and no extension. What adjustment applies?** The percentage is raised by 10 points.

**Q. Exactly 24 installment payments, no extension?** Lowered by 5 points; 24 is at least the long-history count.
